release_notes: Build 120 improves Library visual contrast based on the current Factburst interface.
Publication State now uses a dark navy header row with bold gold labels and cyan separators so every column title remains readable.
The Library More button now uses a saturated blue-violet outline instead of the pale border that appeared white against the dark action bar.
Regression checks protect both visual fixes.
Build 119 current-shell startup and Library publication-state integration remain included unchanged.
